          ∀ Φ,
            True -∗

def mvcc.api.KV.Compact.contractC (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName) (trace : Loc) (te : Bool) (rev : w64) (q : Qp) (B : mvcc.api.MvccStorage) (P : IProp GF)
    (f : GoFunc) (Pre Q' Post X Y : IProp GF) (Q : mvcc.api.MvccState → IProp GF),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.api.isMvcc (interface.mkOk ty v) γ ∗
              mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ∗
                ⌜trace ≠ null⌝ ∗
                  ⌜1 ≤ sint.Z rev⌝ ∗
                    traceutil.ownTrace trace te ∗
                      mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                        mvcc.api.hookIs B f ∗
                          X ∗
                            mvcc.api.storageReq B P X Y ∗
                              Pre ∗
                                mvcc.api.hookRun P f Pre Q' ∗
                                  (Q' ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ Post) ∗
                                    AU <{ ∃∃ σ, mvcc.api.mvccState γ σ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑mvcc.api.mvccN, ∅ <{
                                        mvcc.api.mvccState γ
                                          (if σ.crev < sint.Z rev ∧ sint.Z rev ≤ ↑σ.rev then σ.compactTo (sint.Z rev)
                                          else σ),
                                        COMM Q σ }> -∗
          (▷
              ∀ ch err,
                (mvcc.api.mvccOpen γ ∗
                    traceutil.ownTrace trace te ∗
                      mvcc.api.mvccBackend γ q B P ∗
                        ∃ σ,
                          Q σ ∗
                            (⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ σ.crev < sint.Z rev ∧ sint.Z rev ≤ ↑σ.rev⌝ ∗
                                Post ∗ Y ∗ mvcc.api.compactChanRecv ch ∨
                              ⌜sint.Z rev ≤ σ.crev⌝ ∗
                                  typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.ErrCompacted) err
                                      DFrac.discard ∗
                                    Pre ∗ X ∗ mvcc.api.compactChanRecv ch ∨
                                ⌜↑σ.rev < sint.Z rev ∧ ch = chan.nil⌝ ∗
                                  typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.ErrFutureRev) err
                                      DFrac.discard ∗
                                    Pre ∗ X)) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal ch, intoVal err)) -∗
            WP (((intoVal (methods ty go!"Compact" v)) (intoVal trace)) (intoVal rev))
              {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.api.compactChan.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (ty : go.GoType) (v : val) (γ : mvcc.api.MvccName),
    mvcc.api.isMvcc (interface.mkOk ty v) γ ⊢ ⌜mvcc.api.KV.Compact.contractC ty v⌝
